mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may increase seizure risk and reduce praziquantel efficacy in parasitic infections; praziquantel may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing bumetanide exposure.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) regularly during concurrent use; consider potassium-sparing diuretic or supplementation; assess clinical response to praziquantel therapy.
